title: Commercial Real Estate Legal Secretary
description:
Our Legal 200 client is seeking an experienced Commercial Real Estate Legal Secretary to join their busy Real Estate team in Milton Keynes. The firm offers an excellent benefits package, including private healthcare, Perkbox, generous annual leave and a range of additional employee benefits.
You will work closely with lawyers and partners, providing secretarial and administrative support across a variety of Commercial Real Estate matters, ensuring transactions run smoothly and efficiently. You will also assist other departments when capacity allows.

What will be expected of you in this Commercial Real Estate Legal Secretary role:
- A minimum of three years' experience in commercial property, with a broad understanding of general commercial property matters.
- Knowledge of landlord and tenant law, including commercial leases.
- Ability to prepare standard-form legal documents using templates, including Land Registry certificates.
- Assisting with client correspondence, drafting letters, emails and legal documents under supervision, with strong drafting and proofreading skills.
- File management, organising client documents and maintaining accurate records.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office, legal document management systems and online portals such as HighQ.
- Familiarity with AI systems such as Copilot within a legal environment.
- A proactive team player with good practical and financial awareness and the ability to work to deadlines under pressure.

Benefits for this Commercial Real Estate Legal Secretary role:
- Salary up to £29,400pa DOE.
- 24 days' holiday, increasing to 26 days.
- BUPA Private Healthcare.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Income Protection Scheme.
- Death in Service Benefits.
- Perkbox / Benefits Hub.

About the Firm:
A Top 200 private practice with excellent client and employee reviews. Recognised in the Legal 500 and holding Lexcel, CQS, Cyber Essentials Plus and B Corp accreditations, the firm is known for its expertise, innovation and commitment to quality, sustainability and professional excellence.

If you are an experienced Commercial Real Estate Legal Secretary looking for your next career move, apply today! Alternatively, contact Mia at Law Staff Limited, quoting reference 37924.

title: Paralegal
description:
Paralegal

Location: Milton Keynes

Salary: Up to £27,000 DOE
Hours: Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week
Contract: Permanent Fully office-based

We are recruiting for an enthusiastic, organised and people-focused Paralegal to join a well-established, people-centric legal practice based in Milton Keynes.

This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy, supportive team environment, enjoys building relationships and takes pride in delivering an exceptional client experience. You'll play a key role in supporting the legal team, keeping things running smoothly and ensuring clients receive a first-class service.

Ideally, you'll have experience within Private Client or Crime & Litigation, although candidates with previous legal administration, Team Assistant or Legal Secretary experience will also be considered.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing day-to-day administrative and paralegal support to lawyers.
- Managing client files from opening through to closure.
- Preparing legal documents and handling correspondence.
- Managing diaries, inboxes, appointments and deadlines.
- Liaising with clients and acting as a first point of contact.
- Maintaining accurate case management records and ensuring compliance.
- Supporting billing, payments and general file administration.
- Working collaboratively with the wider team to deliver excellent client service.

Skills & Experience Required
- Previous experience in a Paralegal, Legal Secretary or Team Assistant role.
- Ideally Private Client or Crime & Litigation experience.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and document production skills.
- Confident using IT and case management systems.
- A proactive, flexible and professional approach.

If you're looking for your next opportunity within the legal sector and have the experience we're looking for, please apply today!

title: Paralegal - Employment
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Paralegal - Employment based in Milton Keynes for one of our clients on a Full time permanent basis.

Summary of the Paralegal - Employment role

Salary: £27,000
Location: Milton Keynes - maybe required to travel to the Bedford office on occasion
Type of Contract: Permanent
Hours: 37.5 hours Monday Friday 9am-5.30pm

Responsibilities of the Paralegal - Employment
- Manage own time effectively to facilitate cash flow and credit management systems
- Manage a mixed caseload of client matters subject to appropriate supervision
- Deal with administrative aspects from file opening to closing
- Transcribing dictation
- Scanning and allocating post to matter file in SOS and notifying lawyers of incoming communications
- Management of outgoing post
- Management of electronic documents and document release requests
- Keeping lawyers up to date on the progress of tasks
- Diary and inbox management
- Taking reception overflow calls
- Financial management of matters
- Interact with clients including telephone discussions/meeting and greeting at appointments
- Processing new enquiries

Requirements for a successful Paralegal - Employment
- Previous experience in a similar role or an experienced team assistant/legal secretary looking for next career move
- Employment experience desirable
- Excellent communication skills
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
